name: Harp
notes:
harpSeed: CELTIC HARP — a bright, clean, long-RINGING plucked string (Karplus-
Strong, like the guitars but more OPEN/shimmering): a brighter clear pluck, a
much longer free sustain (the strings ring out), and a lighter soundboard than
a guitar's box. Reference: celtic harp G2 (daphne_in_wonderland, CC0).

amp_env.notes:
amp_attack: instant pluck transient
amp_decay: long ring-out (schema max for amp_decay is 4.0 -- see modular_recipe.go)

body.notes: body_model: light soundboard coloration (harps are more open than a guitar box)

layers.notes:
gen1_ks_pluck: bright, clear, shimmering pluck
gen1_ks_sustain: 2026-08-22 tuning round: refs diagnose measured ring T60 1.9x too short
(ref 1.95s vs synth 1.04s, at the corpus's own render pitch ~777Hz —
the "harp-freesound-alt" ref's DetectF0 locks onto a HIGH note, see the
AGENTS.synth.instruments.md note on this reference). KS loop-gain math:
T60 = ln(1000)/(ln(1/ks_sustain)*f0 + 1/amp_decay); at 0.993 that gave
~1.2s. Raised ks_sustain 0.993->0.997 (halves the loop-gain deficit) and
amp_decay 3.5->4.0 (the master envelope no longer clips the ring as
short; 4.0 is the ParamDef schema's declared max for amp_decay --
modular_recipe.go's `{Name: "amp_decay", ... Max: 4}` -- an earlier pass
at 6.0 rendered fine here but silently diverged from the no-edit fast
path, which clamps to the schema bound before rendering; caught by
TestModularNoEditFastPathMatchesRecipe/harp) to close the gap toward
the reference's ~1.95s. longer ring — harp strings sustain freely
